issues.description: The template defines simulate_msd_two_rounds with an instantiation circ = stim.Circuit(p) (passing the noise parameter p to stim.Circuit). The Stim Circuit constructor does not take a depolarizing probability argument; elsewhere in the solution and other functions the circuit is created with stim.Circuit() (no parameter). This inconsistent use of stim.Circuit(p) in the template is likely an unintentional mistake that will cause a runtime error or confusion when students try to run or implement the function.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove the argument 'p' when constructing a new stim.Circuit in the template (use stim.Circuit()). If the intent was to parameterize noise, handle depolarizing noise via explicit DEPOLARIZE1 operations in the circuit, or document the correct way to apply noise rather than passing it to the Circuit constructor.
